mining_power.balanced_detail:
Everydía mining using about half of your teléfono’s CPU cores. Easy on heat for most people.

Tip: Change the CPU number yourself and the app switches to Personalizado automatically.
mining_power.performance_detail:
Aims for higher hashrate by preferring the teléfono’s faster cores when it has them.

May use more power and run warmer. Best when plugged in and cooled well.

On simple teléfonos without “fast/slow” cores, this matches Balanced.
mining_power.cooler_detail:
Uses fewer cores than Balanced so the teléfono stays cooler and batería lasts longer.

Good for overnight or warm rooms. Switch back to Balanced when you want more speed.
mining_power.custom_detail:
Full manual control. CPU starts from your General setting (or 1).

Temperatura and batería pauses use simple defaults you can change.

Pick Balanced, Performance, or Cooler again anytime to re-apply that profile.
power.pre_mine_summary: Overnight disconnects are usually the teléfono sleeping Wi‑Fi or the app. A short checklist fixes batería, Wi‑Fi sleep, brand savers, and the mining notification.

• Todoow unrestricted batería for VerusMinero
• Keep Wi‑Fi on when the screen is off
• Whitelist the app in brand batería savers
• Leave the mining notification on

general.network_debug_detail:
What it does: Adds a network debug button on the mining screen (works in normal release builds too). It logs whether Wi‑Fi is on, signal strength, and if the pool is reachable.

Why enable it: When mining keeps “retrying”, it is hard to tell if the pool is down or the teléfono put Wi‑Fi to sleep. These logs make that clear so you can fix the right teléfono setting instead of guessing.

Turn it off anytime if you do not need the extra button.

power.intro_detail:
Mineroía keeps talking to the pool over Wi‑Fi (or mobile data) even when the screen is off. Phones try to save power by sleeping apps and Wi‑Fi. When that happens you lose the connection, see endless “retry” messages, and earn less — even though the app looks like it is still running.

A few one-time teléfono settings keep the link stable for overnight mining. It only takes a minute and is the most common fix for mysterious disconnects.
power.wifi_detail:
What to do:
• Older teléfonos — Wi‑Fi settings → Wi‑Fi preferences → Wi‑Fi sleep policy. Pick option 3, “Never”.
  1. When screen turns off — not good for mining (Wi‑Fi sleeps)
  2. Never when charging — OK if you always mine while plugged in
  3. Never — best choice for stable mining
• Newer teléfonos — also turn off “turn off Wi‑Fi when screen is off”, “adaptive connectivity”, or similar power-saving Wi‑Fi options (names vary by brand: Samsung, Xiaomi, Oppo, Pixel, etc.).

Why this helps: The mining pool needs a live connection the whole time. If Wi‑Fi sleeps with the screen, the pool drops you and hashrate stalls until you wake the teléfono.
power.oem_detail:
What to do: In Dispositivo care, Batería, or App power management, put VerusMinero on the “never sleep”, “unrestricted”, or “no restrictions” list. You can re-open app details anytime to confirm.

Why this helps: Many brands add extra batería savers on top of Android. Those can still kill mining even after the normal batería setting looks fine. Whitelisting VerusMinero stops those surprise stops.
power.notification_detail:
What to do: While mining, leave the VerusMinero notification in the status bar. Do not swipe it away.

Why this helps: That small notification tells Android the app is actively working. Without it, the teléfono is more likely to pause mining in the background.
power.locks_detail:
What to do: Nothing extra — VerusMinero does this for you while mining.

Why this helps: The app asks Android to keep the CPU and Wi‑Fi radio from napping during a session. This helps, but it cannot turn Wi‑Fi back on if you (or the teléfono brand) fully disabled it — still complete the steps above.
power.game_detail:
What the app can do: While mining, VerusMinero sends a GameState “gameplay active” hint (Android 13+) so the system may prefer higher clocks. That is not the same as forcing Game Mode = Performance on every brand.

What to do if you have Game Mode / Game Launcher / Game Booster:
1. Abrir Game Launcher, Game Space, Game Turbo, or Game Mode in system settings.
2. Add VerusMinero to the game list if needed.
3. Set the mode to Performance (not Batería Guardarr / Balanced).
4. Leave thermal / “auto FPS” limits off if you only care about CPU mining.

Pulsa “Apply performance hint” to re-send the hint and open app details.

Note: May increase heat and power use. Best when plugged in. Skip if your teléfono has no Game Mode.
power.remind_detail:
What it does: When on, VerusMinero shows this checklist each time you start mining.

Why enable it: Phone updates or batería-saver changes can reset your settings. A short reminder helps you catch that before you leave the teléfono mining overnight.

You can turn this off anytime. The full guide is always available from Ajustes or Dispositivo Información.

power.ambient_summary: Best mining is often around 18–28 °C room temperature. Hotter rooms need better cooling or Cooler profile.
power.ambient_detail:
Phones throttle or get unstable when they overheat. Aim for a cool room (about 18–28 °C).

Above ~28 °C: improve airflow, remove a case if needed, use Cooler profile, or pause when hot.

Below ~18 °C: usually fine for mining — cold air helps keep the chip cool.

This is a comfort tip for the room/environment, not the batería % or in-app temperature pause settings.

power.power_save_detail_off:
El ahorro de energía del sistema está desactivado — el estado preferido para hashrate y un enlace estable al pool.

Nota: puede degradar la batería más rápido que con el ahorro activado. Enchufa cuando puedas. Algunos teléfonos reactivan el ahorro con batería baja — desactívalo si la minería se ralentiza por la noche.
power.power_save_detail_on:
Muchos teléfonos tienen un modo aparte de Ahorro de batería / Energía (no es lo mismo que “batería sin restricciones” para una app).

Cuando el ahorro está ACTIVADO, el sistema suele bajar relojes de CPU y limitar la red en segundo plano — cae el hashrate y el pool puede desconectarse.

Para minar, desactiva el Ahorro de energía (o evita que se active solo). Es mejor para minar, pero la batería puede agotarse antes.
